subject: Startups
title: Reading a Cap Table
description: A quick win: understand Reading a Cap Table.

hook.text: A cap table is a spreadsheet that shows who owns what. It's the single most important financial document in a startup.

buildup.text: Cap tables list every shareholder, their share count, share class, and ownership percentage of the company.

discovery.text: Founders, employees, and investors all appear on the cap table. As new rounds happen, everyone's percentage changes.

twist.text: A messy cap table scares investors away. If you can't track who owns what, you can't run a clean fundraise.

climax.text: Tools like Carta and Pulley automate cap table management. Manual spreadsheets cause expensive errors at scale.

punchline.text: Know your cap table cold. It drives every deal you'll ever do.

quiz.question: What does a cap table show?
options: Who owns what percentage of the company
